findings.description: AC4: an initiative kept In Progress only by open pull requests readied its epics (board-queue.py place_sets, activate, park). Verified fixed at head: place_sets adds a waiting next-set or lower initiative to Queue.waiting, Queue.activate returns before placing candidates for a waiting initiative, and Queue.park returns a waiting initiative's open epics to In Progress when active and Backlog otherwise; decide adds a waiting unplanned initiative too. Observed by test_an_initiative_waiting_in_the_next_set_readies_no_epic and its siblings.

deliver.py survey gave every unit a task branch and worktree per epic base whether or not it changes that long-lived branch. Verified fixed at head: survey calls changed_bases, which keeps only the bases whose long-lived branch a row's work-item Component declaration (branch:path) names, and reports undeclared rows (exit 1) instead of offering the unit; task_branches then names one branch per changed base. Observed by test_a_unit_takes_only_the_epic_bases_its_rows_change and test_a_unit_of_several_bases_declaring_none_is_undeclared.

Record Epic Delivery callers in deliver-mode.md, review-pull-request.md, epic-issue-body.md, align-mode.md and sync-mode.md omitted the fetched epic bases. Verified fixed at head: every Run/Re-run/Repeat of Record Epic Delivery in those files, task-merge.md and issue-delivery.md passes the fetched epic bases, and Record Epic Delivery maps each to --revision. Observed by test_documents.py EpicDeliveryCallers.

sync.py title_repairs ran before epic_delivery applied --link, so a pull request linked in the same run was prefix-checked only next run. Verified fixed at head: main calls title_repairs after epic_delivery, over rows epic_delivery has rewritten in place. Observed by test_pull_request_linked_in_the_run_is_checked_for_its_prefix_in_that_run.

test_board_queue.py test_unstarted_epics_return_without_an_assignee_and_done_stays asserted an assignee string a POST also matched. Verified fixed at head: the test asserts the full gh api --method DELETE calls for issues 1 and 3 and asserts no --method POST repos/o/r/issues/ call.

board-queue.py activate left an inactive epic In Progress under a waiting initiative. Verified fixed at head: Queue.park, for every initiative in Queue.waiting, places each open epic not In Review or Done at In Progress when active and Backlog otherwise, covering next-set, lower and unplanned waiting initiatives; activate also returns an inactive In Progress epic whose prerequisites are unmet to Backlog. Observed by test_an_inactive_epic_in_progress_under_a_waiting_initiative_returns_to_backlog (three subtests) and test_an_active_epic_under_a_waiting_initiative_is_in_progress.

board-queue.py Queue.place_sets demoted an initiative that board.py holds In Progress: the waiting check read only open delivery pull requests, so a next-set initiative whose listed epic was In Review with only its integration pull request open, or held only by a session's reserved row, was set Ready and board delivery set it back. Verified fixed at d46bc872: Queue.holding names the open delivery pull requests, each open listed epic In Review, and each active listed epic with no such pull request; Queue.wait applies it in the next set, lower sets and to an unplanned initiative. Probes at d46bc872 of the integration-only In Review case and the reservation-only case (prioritised and unplanned) now print 'wait #1 [I01] Low: Current: E00 In Review' / 'E00 held by a session' and leave I01 In Progress. Observed by test_an_epic_in_review_or_held_by_a_session_keeps_its_initiative_waiting and test_an_unplanned_initiative_holding_a_reservation_waits. Wait now precedes shelve in place_sets and decide, so park handles the waiting initiative's epics and shelve's reconcile line is reached only by a Ready initiative, consistent with board-queue.md.

deliver.py changed_bases reported a free row of a multi-base epic that links no work item as undeclared, so its unit was never offered although its session writes the work item after dispatch (Run Delivery Session step 3). Verified fixed at d46bc872: changed_bases adds every epic base's long-lived name for a row with no linked work item, a linked work item that is unreadable or names no base stays undeclared, and delivery-branches.md (Unplanned rows), delivery-plan.md and deliver-mode.md step 7 state that the unit takes every base and opens a pull request only from each branch its work changes. Observed by test_an_unplanned_row_of_several_bases_takes_every_epic_base and test_an_unplanned_row_joined_to_a_declared_row_takes_every_epic_base.

board-queue.py read an open epic whose criteria are all ticked but whose agent review is missing or stale as unstarted: Queue.activate placed it Ready, Queue.park Backlog under a waiting initiative, Queue.shelve treated it as unstarted, and Queue.holding did not count it, while board.py main holds it In Progress (handoff blocked). Verified fixed at 318850f2: handed_off(issue, held) is true for In Review, Done, closed, or open with board.criteria_met, the same predicate board.py main tests before activity; Queue.activate and Queue.park skip such an epic, Queue.holding names it 'awaiting review', and Queue.shelve names it '(awaiting review)' on a reconcile line. The probe that failed at d46bc872 (I01 In Progress, E00 with merged #8, AC1 ticked, integration pull request open, no review record, held In Progress) now prints 'the queue is current'; as a lower set it prints 'wait #1 [I01] Low: Current: E00 awaiting review' and leaves I01 and E00 in place. A ticked epic that also has a reserved row or open task pull request is skipped by activate and park and named awaiting review, which agrees with board.py, whose criteria_met branch precedes its activity branch. Observed by EpicHandoff tests test_the_queue_leaves_it_in_progress_under_its_running_initiative, test_it_holds_its_initiative_waiting_in_every_set and test_a_returning_initiative_names_it_for_reconciliation.
